defs.def: the lowest part of sth 底部；最下部

ex.s: You'll place the dot at the bottom of the vertical axis because in this instance you have $0 available for movie tickets.
ex.t: 你会把点放在纵轴的底部，因为在这种情况下你有0美元可用于买电影票。

ex.s: Written across the bottom are the names of the members of the running teams that have brought McFarland nine state championships over the past twenty years.
ex.t: 底部横排印着那些跑步队队员的名字，他们在过去二十年里为麦克法兰赢得了九次州冠军。

defs.def: the part of sth that faces downwards and is not usually seen （朝下的）底，底面

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 但我内心深处有一种无论如何都要攀登那座山的冲动。我迫不及待地想要再次尝试这次冒险。

ex.s: The white bags were then deflated in about half an hour to lower the sequoia's root ball to the bottom of its hole, The bags were removed, but the metal bars were left with the tree because they rust and degrade over a number of years.
ex.t: 然后白色气囊在约半小时内放气，将红杉根球降到坑底，气囊被取出，但钢条留在树旁，因为它们会在数年内生锈降解。

ex.s: In America, just like in China, the "first floor" is at the bottom level and the one above it is the "second floor".
ex.t: 在美国，就像在中国一样，first floor是在最底层，它上面一层是second floor。

ex.s: Background information In Britain, the floor of a building at the bottom level is called the "ground floor" and the floor above it is called the "first floor".
ex.t: 背景信息：在英国，大楼最底层的楼面被称为"ground floor"，它上面一层被称为"first floor"。

defs.def: the lowest surface on the inside of a container （容器内的）底
the ground below the water in a lake, river, swimming pool, etc. （湖、河、游泳池等的）底；水底

ex.s: Now the trunks of trees on the bottom, and the old log canoe, and the dark surrounding woods, are gone, and the villagers, who scarcely know where it lies, instead of going to the pond to bathe or drink, are thinking to bring its water...
ex.t: 如今水底树干、旧木独木舟和四周幽暗的树林都已不在，村民们几乎不知池塘所在，不再去池边沐浴饮水，反倒想着引来它的水……

defs.def: the part of sth that is furthest from you, your house, etc. … 尽头
the lowest position in a class, on a list, etc; a person, team, etc. that is in this position （班级、名单等的）最末位置；排名最后的人（或团队等）
the part of the body that you sit on 屁股；臀部
the lower part of a set of clothes that consists of two pieces 套装的裙（或裤）
the lower part of a ship that is below the surface of the water （吃水线以下的）船底，船身
having the type of bottom mentioned 构成形容词

ex.s: Reaching as far as the eye can see, these terraces cover tall mountains, often from the bottom to the very top.
ex.t: 这些梯田延绵至目力所及之处，覆盖着座座高山，常常从山脚一直延伸到山顶。
